Name: Sam Gets a Makeover
Author: glubtier
Description:
[b][u]Sam needed a makeover.

[/u][/b]So I gave him one! Changes include:
[list]
[*]Outfit change in both portraits and sprites
[*]A black suit for the Flower Festival
[*]A haircut to bring him into the last decade
[*]A bonus portrait for dialog mods
[/list]
This mod will eventually supplement my Sam story overhaul. (10/15/2019 -- This may yet happen. Maybe. But don't wait around.)

[s]I recommend using [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-xnb-loader.4506/]XNB Loader[/url] though it's not required.[/s] Updated for Content Patcher.

Downloads.Description: This version requires Content Patcher and SMAPI. Updated for 1.4.
